claims.claim: StreamElement fields (incl. Reasoning)
Stage interface Name/Type/Process
Stage types: 5 StageType values; no Observe type
TemplateStage, RecordingStage and MessageBroadcastStage are StageTypeTransform
Text-mode order includes recording_input after template and recording_output after provider
VAD stage order audio_turn, stt, provider, tts_interruptible
Execute creates channels sized ChannelBufferSize, default 32
Shutdown(ctx) waits for in-flight executions; ErrShutdownTimeout after GracefulShutdownTimeout (10s); abandoned executions drop output only once the reader is gone, ending in ErrOutputTruncated
Execute returns ErrPipelineShuttingDown after shutdown
Branch downstream stages share and compete for the upstream output channel; RouterStage sends to chosen outputs
Build rejects no stages, invalid config, duplicate names, unknown edge targets, cycles, fan-in into a non-MultiInputStage, duplicate edges, and TemplateStage/PromptAssemblyStage without TurnState
A stage error ends the turn without canceling other stages; downstream stages get the error in-band; the caller gets a *StageError unless the stage emitted it as an error element
Pipeline events emitted per stage and pipeline
RecordingStage re-captures history each turn (N copies)
RecordingStage event mapping message/audio/image/video/toolcall/error
MessageBroadcastStage added when emitter configured; strips binary
ProviderStage copies ProviderRequestMetadata each call
IncrementalSave merges metadata (only on full-save fallback)
Load stages copy ConversationID/UserID to TurnState
Latency targets table (<10ms, <50ms, ~1-2ms)
Stages read input in send order unless PipelineConfig.PrioritizeElements is set, which makes each stage deliver higher-priority elements first
Element pooling available
Voice chain snippet constructors and signatures
Builder methods Chain/Connect/Branch/Merge/AddStage
RouterStage routes by returned names; MergeStage fans in

MaxConcurrentPipelines (default 100) bounds concurrent executions; Execute waits for a slot; IdleTimeout default 30s and ExecutionTimeout default 0 fail the turn with ErrIdleTimeout/ErrExecutionTimeout

BroadcastRouter copies every element to every downstream stage; Content/RoundRobin/Weighted/Hash/Random pick one destination by name and drop elements bound for unregistered names; the pipeline registers a per-edge channel per downstream stage and every router closes all of them when Process returns
